name: CSRE1/CSRE2 resonance-analysis and verification vertical slice

decision.decision: Use WLC-001 as the common workload for centralized-modular, federated, and local-first-hybrid architecture comparisons.
decision.scope_note: The workload identity, deterministic core inputs, and reference algorithm are frozen. Architecture-specific run protocol, resource envelope, repetitions, and performance thresholds remain separate and are not yet frozen.

alpha_A_analytical_damped.method: Underdamped natural frequency from the linear viscously damped oscillator model

reference_analytical_undamped.method: Undamped natural frequency; retained as a boundary/reference value, not the primary damped-system oracle

alpha_B_numerical.method: Source-faithful explicit Euler state update and zero-crossing estimator from the historical DigitalTwin fragment

beta_verification.method: Independently recompute analytical damped reference and compare the deterministic numerical estimate
beta_verification.note: This is a numerical-method discrepancy for this fixed integration step and estimator. It is not an architecture-performance acceptance threshold.

derived_harness.determinism: Fixed inputs; no wall clock, random identifiers, sensor noise, network access, or external services
derived_harness.test_scope: Analytical references, source-faithful numerical reference, repeatability, epistemic-limit label, input validation, and underdamped-domain validation

workflow.alpha_B: Compute numerical transient response using the recovered DigitalTwin update sequence.
workflow.beta: Independently recompute the damped analytical reference and report numerical discrepancy.
workflow.gamma: No production authority or consequential target operation is present in WLC-001; authority/fencing gates remain owned by existing test families and target-source verification.
workflow.sigma: Produce a provenance-linked comparison view without promoting model agreement to empirical or physical validation.

determinism_and_exclusions.clock_and_ids: Historical agent code uses wall-clock-derived IDs; excluded from the deterministic numerical core. Architecture integration may use fixed IDs only if declared in the run manifest.
determinism_and_exclusions.sensor_noise: Historical SensorHardwareGateway uses Gaussian noise without a source-recorded seed; excluded from the frozen deterministic core. A separately versioned noisy-sensor extension requires a declared RNG algorithm and seed.
determinism_and_exclusions.source_integrity: The historical source compilation is not modified. The harness is a separate derived implementation with explicit attribution.
determinism_and_exclusions.integration_gap: The historical main orchestration hardcodes simulated_measurement=1.59155 and does not call the separate DigitalTwin implementation. The harness explicitly composes the two methods; this is new derived benchmark code, not a recovered original call-site.

epistemic_limit: The result demonstrates internal analytical/numerical model comparison only. It does not constitute empirical measurement, experimental validation, hardware validation, or physical validation.

remaining_items: Pin each architecture implementation commit and document fidelity asymmetries.
Freeze common host/runtime resource envelope and isolation conditions.
Freeze workload invocation, concurrency/load schedule, fault-injection schedule, and repetition count.
Freeze raw observation schema, metric calculations, and stopping rule.
Record owner-defined architecture performance thresholds after baseline measurements; do not invent them.
